rules: Every source retains its original locator and historical identity.
Library file_id/version_id is a stable discovery locator but is not a Git SHA or content digest.
A-01 may compute and verify digests only for bytes actually presented to it.
Conflicting or unavailable historical identity remains explicit and is never normalized away.
Derived summaries are not substitutes for source bytes or exact receipts.
Full asset census expands this registry append-only or by a versioned successor.
